G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa requested staff to look at what other cities are doing to address Airbnb complaints.

Councilmember De Paula reported that he attended the League of California Cities Annual Conference;
visited Hawaiian Elementary School for Mexican Independence Day; and visited Tracy High School for
their back to school open house.

Mayor Del Rio thanked staff for the Fun Run Day event; reported that she attended the League of
California Cities Annual Conference; and requested that the meeting be adjourned in memory of Ryan
Clinkunbroomer.

I.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

J.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting in memory of Ryan Clinkunbroomer at 6:45 PM to the next
Regular City Council meeting to be held on Tuesday, October 10, 2023 at 6:00 PM.
